model: RIBMNWLB-7-BC fan safety circuit / relay module
equipment_type: Other equipment (BACnet relay / fan safety module)
applies_to: Functional Devices RIBMNWLB-7-BC (also RIBTWLB-7-BC, RIBTWLB-7-BC-N4) 2-relay, 8-input module that runs as a fan safety circuit by default.
summary: A BACnet MS/TP module with two relays and eight binary inputs. From the factory it runs a stand-alone fan safety circuit: BO1 only closes when BI1-BI6 are all closed, BI1-BI6 can latch, and BO2 follows BI7. The safety function can be turned off so it works as a plain 2-relay, 7-input RIB.
notes: Object names are user-writable and the PICS prints no factory default name, so each object is listed by its printed ID (BI1, BO1...). BV1 defaults to "CLR Latches".

Fan-safety logic is set through proprietary properties (277001-277009) on BO1, BO2 and BI1-BI6, not through extra objects: AND_Function_Enable, AND_Output_Stat and AND_Output_Priority (default 12) on BO1, Bind_BI7 and its priority (default 12) on BO2, Latch_Enabled and Input_Latched on BI1-BI6.
DIP switches give hand ON/OFF/AUTO on BO1 and BO2 at priority 8 (writable); BI1-BI6 latching is chosen by DIP switch.
BI8 is wired to the latch reset pushbutton, not a field input.

integration.summary: In fan-safety mode, start the fan through BO1 and read BI1-BI6 to find which safety tripped; clear latches with BV1. To use it as a plain relay module, set AND_Function_Enable (BO1) and Bind_BI7 (BO2) to 0.

minimum_points.name: BO1
minimum_points.why: Fan start relay (AND of BI1-BI6 in safety mode)

integration.enable: Fan-safety mode is on by default (BO1 proprietary property AND_Function_Enable = 1); set it to 0 to drive BO1 freely.
setup: The PICS prints the device object ID default as DE277000 (vendor ID 277); it is writable.
MS/TP master; baud rates are listed in the PICS. Max_Master defaults to 127.
DIP switch hand/off/auto on BO1 and BO2 acts at priority 8; the AND and BI7 bindings act at priority 12.
gotchas: A BMS write to BO1 at a priority below 12 is overridden while the AND function holds it off.
Latched safety inputs stay latched until BV1, the local pushbutton or a power cycle resets them.
